hero.subtitle: What was once broken, can be reforged

about.body: Recovery is a conscious chain of decisions of choosing a better life, taming anxiety, and accessing deeper understanding of our lives. Founded on modern individual and positive psychology and Eastern philosophy, Reforged Light offers a direct path to recovery, stability, transformation, and enlightenment to meet life at any stage.

aboutPage.subtitle: About
aboutPage.headline: Guiding others toward sobreity through strength, choice, and presence.
aboutPage.imageAlt: Alex - Program facilitator and sobriety coach
paragraphs: My journey into sobriety began through my own path of recovery, decisions, and internal transformation more than 10 years ago. After attempting to recover using all the tools, methods, and approaches the West had to offer, I discovered the freedom of choice offered with Adlerian Psychology, Eastern philosophy, and the Will to Meaning. The ability to control my mind, body, and path quite literally saved my life and allowed me to choose what I wanted to build moving forward.

Today, I work tirelessly to helping others find the same peace of mind, control, and tranquility that these methods have brought me. I truly believe that each person is the master of their own will, they just have not been able to access and use it properly.

As a sobriety coach and mentor, I combine an evidence-based psychological approach with a philosophical understanding to help a person see their own choices and what choices their will allows them to make. Whether you're seeking sobriety, continued support, or a deeper understanding of yourself, I'm here to guide you in those discoveries.

My approach is centered in understanding, presence, deliberate action and the acknowledgment that no matter the life around us, we are in control above all else. Every path and sessions is tailored to your personal experience and needs on this journey.
aboutPage.quote: When we accept responsibility for being alive, we begin to exist. If we exist, then we can be responsible. If we can be responsible, then we have a choice of how to exist.

benefits.imageAlt: Balanced stacking rocks in water representing calm and stability
benefits.title: Transform the voice between you and yourself
benefits.body: Our evidence-based sobriety programs help you remove stress, anxiety, and nervousness, transmuting them into states of clarity, stability, and harmony. Whether you're starting your path or reinforcing your strength, we begin where you start.
listItems: Conscious control of agitation and stillness
Understanding of self and your surroundings

steps.title: Awareness of the self
steps.body: Understanding of the choices that led to the now, where you are, and the choices that lay ahead.

steps.title: The Power of Choice
steps.body: The ability to see the choices ahead, make them, and follow through.

steps.title: Responsiblity of Action
steps.body: Responsiblity for actions after making a decision leads to desired outcomes and a peace with the life being created.

steps.title: Appreciation of the power of will
steps.body: Awareness that you are in control of your responses and decisions, regardless of how events happen around you.

training.body: Learn how to remain composed in times of stress, the power of your choice and will, and the change you can bring to yourself. We use research-based comprehensive methods proven to aid in recovery, promote stability, and reduce anxiety and depression.

cards.title: A personalized approach
cards.body: Learn about the core principals of your own mind, how choices are made, and your own drives. Each program is curated based on individual sessions and weekly check-ins.

cards.title: A built in support system
cards.body: Our coaches are available 24-7 for any of your possible needs throughout your journey. You will have access to support where and when you need it.

cards.title: A different approach to recovery
cards.body: The program includes exercises that help you gain insight into your own understanding of the world and self. The program includes daily check-ins and guided support, in addition to weekly sessions on your schedule, personalized lessons, and unique exercises.

cards.title: Continuing Support and Community
cards.body: Even after the program ending, you will have access to our coaches and community for support, guideance, and help for any questions that may arise, and celebration for all your achievements.

programs.imageAlt: Person walking down stairs representing the journey forward
programs.title: Find the right path for your journey
programs.body: From introductory sessions to advanced facilitator training, we offer programs designed for every stage of your breathwork journey. Connect with experienced guides who understand the science and the soul of conscious breathing.
